extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: DominionStar Meet uses your camera only when you choose to turn video on in a meeting.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DominionStar Meet uses your microphone only when you choose to use audio in a meeting.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: DominionStar Meet uses screen capture only when you explicitly choose to share a screen or application.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: DominionStar Meet captures system audio only when you explicitly choose to share audio with your screen.
